purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-hoshuu) system - vacant patient number list processing
purpose.summary: This program (ORCBZ001) is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It generates a list of vacant/available patient registration numbers (kuki-kanja-bangou ichiran). It initialises system parameters, reads system management master data for patient number format configuration, validates the number format structure, and prepares print output.

notable_features: 19 COPY statements referencing ORCA-specific copybooks (CPCOMMONDAT2.INC, HCMZ001.INC, CPSYSKANRI.INC, CPSK1009.INC, CPJOBKANRI.INC, CPPRTKANRI.INC, CPPRTDATA.INC, CPORCBZ001S.INC, CPORCSKANACHK.INC, CPORCSJOBKANRI.INC, CPORCSPRT.INC, CPORCSDAY.INC, CPORCSLNK.INC, CPORCSFDEL.INC, MCPAREA, MCPDATA.INC, CPORCMCP.INC, COMMON-SPA, CPORCSPRTLNK.INC)
15 CALL statements to ORCA subsystem routines
UNSTRING COMMAND-PARAM for comma-delimited parameter parsing
EVALUATE with multiple ALSO conditions for patient number format logic
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as mojibake)
MCP (Message Control Program) style DB access pattern
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
verdict.notes: Source comments are in Japanese EUC-JP encoding, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system (circa 2003). No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS; uses proprietary MCP-based database access. Fixed format with a few lines slightly over 72 chars (5 long lines noted).
